scope: Independent static scientific/content cross-review of four files authored by vm_live_tz_review plus independent recomputation of saved transition arithmetic and annual coverage. No fit, SSH, browser, data mutation or model selection.
author_independence: Reviewer did not author the four primary files. Reviewer authored the five separately listed companion files and previous science/content; their inclusion as hashes is not independent authorship review.

checks.statement: All 4 primary files read as final source; active config/month and fixed story scopes distinguished.
69 saved adjacent transition panels checked against exact raw labels, shared IDs and frozen from_raw_to_raw mappings.
Each of 72 config-month panels has matching assigned counts, cluster-size sum and raw-to-display mappings.
At each shared observed adjacent pair, changed display color equals changed membership after mapping; raw label number is not treated as identity.
Territory-level switch and compared-pair sums equal saved transition totals. Missing observations are not connected across gaps.
Complete and incomplete histories separated; no claim of 24-month stability from an incomplete record.
Passport observed values, medians and percentile denominators use selected month; missing values are not zero; even-size median helper is correct.
Annual observation coverage 1666/2190 and 69 regions independently counted; three displayed annual fields exist on every covered ID.
Annual context6 separated from monthly SSE6; salary of organization employees not called resident income; 2023 retrospective attachment is disclosed.
June/December subsample summaries are whole-partition statistics, not per-territory membership probability or all-month resampling.
Fixed story is explicitly NCut10 December 2024, preserving ten groups while illustrating only two extremes. Source comparisons are group medians, not each member.
Graph is displayed union of top5 positive connections including ties, not all edges, financial flow or geographic layout; X0/X1 projection scope explicit.
SSE6 called a separate coarse alternative, not a parent hierarchy. G6/G8/G9 merge291-to333 and G7 limitations agree with accepted scientific review.
No causality, universal functional-type, competitive superiority or probability-of-correctness claim in the reviewed files.
Resolved text checks: unsupported per-capita absent; ambiguous transformed six-dimensional wording replaced with multidimensional.

resolved_findings.resolution: Author removed all per-capita wording; exact accepted definition is model estimate of mean residents cashless spending for a month.

resolved_findings.issue: Six-dimensional wording conflated 7 stored L+h+CLR5 coordinates with 6 independent dimensions.
resolved_findings.resolution: Author uses multidimensional wording; X0/X1 projection remains explicit.

companion_corrections_not_independent_he.change: r04 scope accurately states path-reader/export guard and documentation; computational result bytes remain r03.
Human profile number and native raw group shown separately, e.g. Profile1/G0.
27 historical rows additionally show stored fitting_similarity, fitting_edges and comparison_axis.

runtime_boundary.typecheck_and_site_build: Root reported pass; logs available but exit status not independently captured by this reviewer. Production browser acceptance is separate.

scientific_limits: Computational acceptance does not establish universal economic types or superiority to competitors.
SSE6 resampling evidence covers June and December 2024, with K10 reference results reused on the same draw IDs.
SSE6 administrative sensitivity remains untested; NCut10 administrative dependence remains a limitation.
Negative cluster-filter analogue result is not repaired by the UI; no causal dynamics claim.
